## Preface {.unnumbered}

Welcome to DS310, _Data Mechanics_!

These are the course lecture notes for DS310, covering the foundations of
data management: database design, the relational model and SQL, storage and
indexing, transactions and recovery, data warehousing, and distributed and
NoSQL systems.


## Format {.unnumbered}

This course notes site is built using [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and all
the source pages are in Quarto markdown files. Each link below opens a
reveal.js deck.
